frequency_question: What proportion of proposed major fee rulemakings reach official finalization within 272 days of initial public notice?
membership_rule: Includes: economically significant fee-setting rules proposed by federal regulatory agencies. Excludes: emergency interim rules without prior notice, non-fee regulatory changes, and rules withdrawn prior to public comment.

cases.name: SEC Consolidated Audit Trail Fee Rule (2016)
EPA Hazardous Waste Generator Improvements Fee (2016)
FDA Generic Drug User Fee Amendments (2017)
OSHA Injury Tracking Application Fee Rule (2018)

coverage_note: 8 named; selected as a representative sample of major fee rulemakings across recent administrations.
known_gaps: Excludes minor agency adjustments and rules undergoing prolonged judicial challenges that span multiple presidential terms.
validity_reason: Administrative Procedure Act timelines and standard federal rulemaking procedural requirements remain stable across this timeframe.
